name: Reflection
overview: Scripture calls believers to a deep reflection on their relationship with God and others, revealing that the heart of man is mirrored in human interactions just as a face is reflected in water (Proverbs 27:19). This reflection encourages strength and courage, trusting in God's faithful presence and promises of peace and hope (Deuteronomy 31:6; Jeremiah 29:11). Central to this reflection is the truth found in Jesus Christ, who is the way, the truth, and the life, and whose truth sets believers free (John 8:32; John 14:6). Genuine reflection also manifests in love among believers, which serves as the defining mark of discipleship (John 13:35).
